activity.notes: After the Hundred Days, Talleyrand again served Louis XVIII as foreign minister from 9 July to 26 September 1815; during the same interval he was also President of the Council. ATLAS records the foreign-ministry office here and does not collapse it into his interrupted 1814–1815 term.
